data.name: 《失调～Dissonance》
data.detailed_description:
The memories you believe in may have been implanted by someone else.
The face you see may have been duplicated.
And you yourself may not be “you” at all.

.....

.....

Dissonance is an immersive first-person psychological thriller narrative game. You will play as multiple characters — including TAEYONG, TEN, RENJUN, and YUTA — carrying out various missions in different locations, gradually piecing together the horrifying truth behind the “Neural Resonance Project.”

This is not a rescue mission. This is an interrogation of the self.

Three years ago, a transnational organization called ORIGIN claimed it could heal trauma by extracting human memories. Soon after, mysterious disappearances began to occur. NCT’s members became entangled in the aftermath — some vanished for years, some were found but had forgotten everything, and some… are sitting right across from your monitor, wearing a face you know all too well, speaking memories you dare not confirm.

In the dark, do not trust everything you see. Even the voice on the other end of the radio may not be trustworthy.

Core Features

🎮 Multiple Narrative Perspectives
Witness different sides of the same desperate tragedy through the eyes (first-person) of four main characters. Each one is both the seeker and the sought.

🔦 Oppressive Exploration Atmosphere
The game contains virtually no character portraits or complex animations — only decaying environments, flickering lights, and appalling experiment logs. This visual restraint delivers an even more intense psychological pressure.

🎧 Life-and-Death Radio Communications
Your teammates are your eyes and ears. Under extreme conditions, radio communication is your sole connection to the other members. Every judgment you make, every answer you give, determines the progress of the mission and the fate of the team — and may even decide whether the person in front of you should be “saved” or “terminated.”

🧠 Memory Prisons and Identity Mysteries
You are not a bystander. As the investigation deepens, you will discover that you yourself are caught in the web. When betrayal, cloning, and memory replacement become routine, how do you determine whether that once-familiar person is real?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (8GB)
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (12GB) / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (12GB)
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
